summary: Fresh-context outcome QA passes for supplied artifacts. Public docs, manifest and icon title name BB Surf; docs preserve Steel attribution/steel-browser compatibility and explain panel states, touch, isolation and checks. Three screenshots show BB Surf in light/dark expanded panels and a 390px compact touch panel, with adjacent conversation and viewer content retained. Limits: no tests rerun or production BB integration inspected. Still images cannot prove pinned hover sampling stops. Root reports 51 tests/types/build and four panel.browser.mjs configurations passed; these are reported observations, not my execution. The 390px fixture has heavy wrapping and crowded subtitle/icons in its narrow left mock launcher. Plugin-page rendering and interactive transitions are not independently observed here. No publication or full production integration is claimed.
